notes: The crash symptom is real, but the issue is a design RFC about an experimental, not-user-visible op (`firrtl.probe`), whose correct handling the reporter explicitly leaves open (lower-to-passive vs. restrict op to passive operands vs. nicer diagnostic). In this firtool-1.148.0 tree the FIRRTL ProbeOp has been removed/replaced by ref.rwprobe (which LowerTypes now explicitly preserves), so the original repro is unconstructible and no single resolution is pinned down by issue, spec, or existing CIRCT convention.
